plotSections.title: Walker's report
bullets: The party is all present, so Walker gives his report before dinner instead of waiting.
Walker went to the old training grounds, met Vecna, and had a short talk. He frames it as shared interests rather than a real deal.
Sylan had asked whether Walker hit any mind-control trouble. That part of the report is not answered.
Sylan wants a spirit investigation tonight and to pursue the lich and his sister later. The others agree to wait until dinner to set out.

plotSections.title: Golden eagle and Nyx
bullets: Vecna was tapping a golden eagle. Placed on the war-table map, it lights the map up.
Walker thinks the eagle is only half of a pair and that the other half is at the palace Vecna used in Nyx, described as headquarters with a big red wall.
Nobody recalls the capital's name. Walker says Sylan is from there. Tries include Next city, New next city, Allen Boo, and alibu.
Sylan says they went back and that "they" picked up the seasman. Dana says the season was shattered, in pieces on the floor.

plotSections.title: Vecna and the sister-skin book
bullets: Walker says he and Vecna have common interests: Vecna wants his book back, the one bound in his dead sister's skin.
Vecna tried to pass that book off as rat skin.
Sylan asks whether her soul might still be in the book. No one answers.
Dana calls Vecna the god of the undead and presses Walker on whether a deal was actually made.

plotSections.title: The helm as a possible phylactery
bullets: Walker says Vecna's hint was tapping the golden eagle; at the time Walker thought Vecna was bored.
Dana argues the helm is the only piece of his armor still left, because Walker took it, and recalls a vision of an ordinary item that would pass under their noses.

She suggests they have been carrying the phylactery while treating the helm as a hat. Walker says the helm is extraordinary and sits over his nose, and he doubts it is the phylactery, but he will let them check.
None of them have examined it. Dana says that would take Detect Magic and arcane investigation. Sylan says Carlkin offered to identify it and was worried Walker had been carrying it.
Sylan asks whether the helm benefits Walker. Dana notes Vecna or the lich has contacted them twice, and Walker has had the helm the whole time but not the eagle.
Dana adds that a phylactery is usually something stored away, not worn.
Ord offers to detect magic. Sylan asks how close Glimmen is. The DM describes wind, dark leaves, and weather abnormally cold for the season. The chunk ends before the helm is checked.

chronologicalEvents: 1. Sylan asks Walker for a report and whether he ran into mind control. Walker instead contrasts that with Sylan's magical darkness and soul-sucking.
2. The party agrees everyone is here. Sylan proposes a spirit hunt tonight, after dinner, and the lich and his sister later.
3. Walker says he met Vecna at the old training grounds and may have made a deal, though not really.

4. Walker shows the golden eagle Vecna was tapping. On the war-table map it lights up. He thinks it is half of a pair and that the other half is at Vecna's Nyx palace, headquarters with a big red wall.
5. The group cannot name Nyx's capital. Sylan says they returned and that the seasman was picked up; Dana says the season was shattered on the floor.
6. Walker says he and Vecna have common interests and that Vecna wants the sister-skin book, which Vecna had passed off as rat skin. Sylan asks if her soul is still in it.
7. Walker says the phylactery hint was Vecna tapping the golden eagle.
8. Dana argues the helm may be the phylactery: last piece of the armor, her vision of an ordinary item under the nose, and two contacts while Walker had the helm but not the eagle.

9. Walker agrees they can check it, doubts it is the phylactery, and says it is not mundane. Dana names Detect Magic and arcane investigation; Sylan cites Carlkin's offer to identify it and Carlkin's concern.
10. Ord offers Detect Magic. Sylan broods and asks how close Glimmen is as the air turns abnormally cold.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter, Gatekeeper of The Reach, bonded to Glimmen.
notes: Went to the old training grounds and spoke with Vecna. He describes common interests rather than a firm deal.
Has the golden eagle Vecna tapped. Putting it on the war-table map lights the map. He thinks it is only one half, with the other half at Vecna's Nyx palace.
Has been wearing the helm the whole time and has not had the eagle the whole time. He grabbed the helm; the party treats it as the only remaining piece of that armor.
Says the helm is extraordinary and worn over the nose, doubts it is a phylactery, and agrees it can be checked.
Does not answer whether the helm benefits him or whether he ran into mind control.
personality: Defensive when the helm and a possible deal with Vecna are questioned.
quotesThemes: He wants his sister-skin book back.
He tried to pass it off as rat skin.
openQuestions: Did the meeting with Vecna include any mind control?

notes: Met Walker at the old training grounds for a short talk.
Tapped the golden eagle on a table. Walker later reads that as a hint and at the time thought Vecna was bored.
Wants the book made from his dead sister's skin. He tried to pass it off as rat skin.
Walker says they have common interests and that it was not really a deal.
Dana says he has contacted the party twice from wherever he is, and ties those contacts to the period Walker had the helm.
Operated from a palace in Nyx that Walker calls headquarters with a big red wall.
openQuestions: Is his sister's soul still in the book?

notes: Wants the spirit problem handled tonight and the lich and his sister afterward.
Presses the party to examine the helm and says refusal would mean they assume it is hindering Walker. He denies threatening Walker.
Says Carlkin offered to identify the helmet and that Sylan can give it back after.
Asks whether Vecna's sister's soul is still in the book.
Walker says Sylan is from Nyx and should know the capital. Sylan does not recall the name.
Asks how close Glimmen is.
openQuestions: Is Vecna's sister's soul still in the book?

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric, Gatekeeper of the Pitel keystone.
notes: Says the season was shattered, in pieces on the floor.
Presses Walker on whether he made a deal with the god of the undead.
Recounts a vision of an ordinary item that would go under their noses and argues the helm may be the phylactery they have been carrying.
Says checking it takes Detect Magic and arcane investigation, and that Carlkin was worried Walker had been carrying it.
Notes he has contacted them twice, and that Walker has had the helm the whole time but not the eagle.
Says a phylactery is usually kept like a treasury object, not worn.
quotesThemes: Wouldn't it be awfully convenient if we had been carrying around the damn thing this whole time because you thought it was a cool hat?

notes: Offers to cast Detect Magic while the helm is being discussed.

Ciri.existing: Half-elf rogue, Gatekeeper connected to Lith.
notes: Agrees to join the spirit outing.
Says "Titan ring" while the group is weighing the helm. The referent is not explained.

Helm.existing: Helm Carlkin agreed to examine. Walker pulled it from Carlkin's burning bag with the golden glove.
notes: Dana says it is the only piece of his armor still remaining because Walker grabbed it.
Dana's vision described an ordinary item that would go under the nose. She wants the helm ruled out as the phylactery.
Walker says it is extraordinary, worn over his nose, and not something unnoticeable, and he doubts it is the phylactery.
No one in the party has examined it yet. Proposed checks are Detect Magic, arcane investigation, and Carlkin.
Carlkin was concerned that Walker had been carrying it.
Walker has had it for both times he contacted them. Walker has not had the golden eagle that whole time.
Sylan asks if it benefits Walker. That is not answered. Ord offers to detect magic as the chunk ends.
Walker produces it after describing Vecna tapping it on a table.
Placed on the war-table map, it makes the map light up.
Walker thinks it is only half and that a counterpart is at Vecna's headquarters in Nyx, the palace with the big red wall.
He has not been carrying the eagle for the whole time he has been carrying the helm.
Dana had asked whether Vecna hinted at the phylactery. Walker points to this tapping.

Raskina.existing: Vecna's red-skinned tome, made from his sister and held by Grixto.
notes: Walker says Vecna wants this book back.
Vecna tried to pass the binding off as rat skin. Walker identifies it as his dead sister's skin.
Sylan asks whether her soul might still be in the book. No answer is given.
openQuestions: Is Vecna's sister's soul still in the book?

Valkyrie.existing: Vecna's sister, killed so her blood and skin could make the Raskina.
notes: Walker says Vecna passed her skin off as rat skin.
Sylan asks if her soul might still be in the book.
openQuestions: Is her soul still in the book?

Carlkin.existing: Turtle-like person, believed to be back in Langdale, who keeps a shop and agreed to examine the helm.
notes: Sylan says Carlkin told them that if they brought the helmet, he could identify it.
Dana says Carlkin was concerned that Walker had been carrying it the whole time.

Training Grounds.existing: Dragon rider training grounds near the Lost Isles.
notes: Walker met Vecna there.

Nyx.existing: A place that may hold hobgoblins who know where the lich is hiding.
notes: Walker says Vecna operated out of a palace there, headquarters with a big red wall, and that the golden eagle's other half might be there.
Walker says Sylan is from Nyx. The capital's name is not remembered.
openQuestions: What is the capital of Nyx called?
Where is the palace headquarters with the big red wall?
